entry.name: ftom
entry.digest: Convert frequency to a MIDI note number
entry.description: ftom converts frequency to MIDI note numbers

arguments.description: If a float value is present, theobject outputs floating-point values with fractional parts. By default, it outputs whole number values.

attributes.name: round
attributes.digest: Round Output
attributes.description: Whenis non-zero,outputs the closest whole MIDI note number value for the frequency it receives. Otherwise if in float mode,outputs a number with a fractional part corresponding to the distance between the two closest MIDI note numbers. Ifis in int output mode, it outputs the MIDI note number at or below the input frequency value. Example: in int mode with other attributes at their default values, 439 would output 69 whenis enabled and 68 whendisabled. 439 is closest to 440 Hz (MIDI note number 69).
